cases.reason: The candidate package explicitly defines itself as one semantic package containing the Markdown root, JSON graph, native graph, and claim-coverage companion. It supersedes the historical NEI and RBA overlays, which are no longer active parallel authorities.
The claim coverage companion reports 93 total claims (74 base plus 19 post-1.1) with 0 uncovered. The 7 open claims remain open and are not solved by package qualification.

Under the qualified q_o congruence theorem, equal q_o on legal nonterminal standard-7x6 states forces the orientation-sensitive literal-action-labelled ordinary future behavior to be SAME under NEI 0.4. This is an exact structural result, so no Bayes factor is required.
Horizontal reflection is an exact automorphism with transporter c -> 6-c when orientations differ. Equal q_r alone does not authorize identical literal column labels without orientation transport.
Equal q_r supports exact scalar W/D/L/value-cache reuse, but non-q proof/certificate identity does not follow because proof context depends on premises not derivable from q.
The q_o future-behavior identity does not imply physical colored-board identity, move-history identity, or physical occurrence identity, as these are finer physical states.

QU-GAME-01 represents cross-lineage statistical independence as a property uncertainty, which is not an identity question. It is represented in QU, but unresolved independence does not establish NEI UNKNOWN for the evidence artifacts.
C4-R0075 identifies the observed rank-35 wall, but does not supply the compact realizability-preserving controllable predecessor law C4-R0076, which remains an open missing law.
An RBA relation closing an exact ordinary value consequence does not transport non-q proof premises (such as deadlines or resources) or establish proof/certificate identity.
In the absence of a qualified likelihood model, a numerical Bayes factor cannot be invented from the count of passing controls. NEI 0.4 strictly forbids fabricating probability distributions.
Claims marked HISTORICAL_ONLY are retained as evidence/provenance and do not disappear, but they are not active game-theory primitives. The package remains complete with 93 covered claims.
IsoMax and BSFP share the same ordinary value dependency semantics but represent different evaluation and materialization schedules over that dependency.
The hot-loop authority has no gameplay authority and cannot redefine game semantics; q_o and q_r semantics remain strictly owned by the game-theory package.
Horizontal reflection is an exact board automorphism, but it does not make a position and its reflection the same physical occurrence.
A Discovery Protocol PASS provides search guidance and structural verification but does not automatically promote open or candidate theorems to exact authority.
Upon promotion, the 1.2 package becomes the current game-theory authority, while authority 1.1 and the old overlays are superseded and retained only as historical evidence.
